title: Cap. V Obj. 8: none can be saved without faith — therefore election from foresight faith
pass_a_gloss: Objection 8. He who according to the will of God cannot be saved without faith is not predestinated to be saved without faith. For there is no secret will of God which is adverse to the revealed. The revealed says, I will not save Peter without faith: There is therefore no secret will which decrees to save the same Peter without faith: and accordingly election unto salvation is from foresight faith.
pass_b_english: Obj. 8. Whoever by God's will cannot be saved without faith is not predestinated to be saved without faith. There is no secret will of God adverse to the revealed. The revealed says, I will not save Peter without faith — so there is no secret will decreeing to save that same Peter without faith. Therefore election unto salvation is from foresight faith.
source_text: Obj. 8. Qui secundum Dei voluntatem absque fide salvari non potest, non praedestinatur salvandus sine fide. Nulla est enim arcana Dei voluntas quae adversatur revelatae. Revelata dicit, Nolo Petrum salvare absque fide: Non est ergo arcana voluntas quae decernit eundem Petrum servare absque fide: ac proinde electio ad salutem est ex fide praevisa.
